english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a small natural freshwater stream, especially one in the countryside or hills.

examples.english: Walking along the creek and listening to the water is really relaxing.
examples.traditional: 我哋沿住條溪澗行，聽住啲水聲真係好舒服。
